description: Reviewed corrections to unit-2 evidence records that were first made directly in tortoise_plant_evidence_v2.json (unit-2 branch, commits 661ede05..82b383e5). build_global_plant_evidence_research_v2.py applies them after building the records from the transcription, so a rebuild reproduces the reviewed file instead of reverting it.
rule: A correction is applied only while the value built from the transcription still equals built_value. If the transcription has changed, the build stops so the correction is reviewed again; it is never applied over a different value.
